decisions.reason: The sports floor system still has unresolved market potential and low carrying cost from existing production, so the option is worth keeping.
The mobile arena system remains a valuable option with uncertain prospects and low incremental cost.
As a duplicate mobile arena system, its value is likely already resolved and redundant, so resources are better shifted elsewhere.
Chevron parquet is close to the established offer and aligns with trend-led interior demand, making its value likely realized and worth keeping.
The squash court finish is a very narrow niche, and after three years its low value is likely resolved, favoring drop.
Oak skirting is a low-value accessory with many alternative options available, so dropping it releases resources.
